rationale: The assistant followed the ideal sequence: ruled out function selector and clock/auto mode, then had the customer isolate at the cooker switch before inspecting the fan element, which matched the hidden truth of a visibly blistered open-circuit element. Confidence was raised only after the visible split, black mark and the 'pop', and the part was offered only after the full model 'IFW 6330 IX' was read from the rating plate. Safety handling was sound throughout ('Keep the cooker isolated at the wall switch and make sure nobody can switch it back on'), with sensible conditional escalation to an engineer if connectors are heat-damaged or the customer is unsure. No repetition, fabrication or unsupported claims were found.
